about: Secrets on screen before anything ships: one still every 2 s at high resolution, each judged alone; a fail lists the timestamps to blur or cut. Measured: a Wi-Fi password card shown 20-26 s in a 48 s short scored 0.93-0.96 on every frame inside the window, at most 0.19 outside; 24 shipped shorts (including a prompter screen full of text) stayed at or under 0.2. For a timeline of a long screen recording use `decide.py scan <file> --every 1 --res high "<ask>" --flag ">=0.4"`.

checks.ask: Private information is readable on screen: a password, Wi-Fi network key, email address, phone number, access code or API key.
